summary: Tested the Absent (Not Arrived) report and the refused-entry tone. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed. They cover the response shape and fields, which statuses are included (only approved students not yet checked in; pending, rejected and checked-in students are left out), the admin branch_id filter, coordinator branch scoping (the branch_id param is ignored for coordinators), a student dropping off the list after a scan, scanner 403, unauthenticated 401/403, and CSV for admin, the admin branch filter, a coordinator without can_export (403), a scanner (403) and a coordinator with export (own branch only). Frontend at 375x667: the dashboard tab 'Not Arrived' opens /staff/absent. Checked the total, branch groups, student cards, call buttons (44px high), search and no-match search, the admin branch chips (All/br-1/br-2/br-3 filter correctly), the CSV download (olam-absent-students.csv), the back button and the coordinator view (own branch only, no chips, export-disabled note). A student scanned in at the gate no longer appears on the list. Scanner: refused-tone.wav played exactly once for ALREADY_CHECKED_IN (twice), NOT_APPROVED, INVALID reference and an INVALID garbage token. welcome-chime.wav played only on VALID. No console or page errors. Deprecated packages detected: none (expo-audio is used). Test data cleaned up.

issues: When a search matches no one, the list is just blank with no message such as 'No matches'. The absent-empty text only shows when total is 0.
The branch heading shows the full count (g.count) even when search has filtered the cards, e.g. 'KALOOR • 5' above 1 card.
For admins the fixed header (title, subtitle and chips) is about 225px tall, so only about 2 cards fit on a 667px screen. Consider letting the header scroll with the list or making it smaller.

action_items: Optional: add a 'No matches' empty state when a search filters out every card on /staff/absent.
Optional: show the filtered count in the branch heading while searching.
Optional: absent.tsx load(): if branch chips are tapped quickly, a slow earlier response can overwrite a newer one. Ignore stale responses with a request id or ref.
Optional: absent_report loads every attendance row into memory. Fine at this size, but a $lookup aggregation or a {registration_id: {$in: ids}} query would scale better.
critical_code_review_comments: absent_report is reused directly by export_absent, so the CSV gets the same branch scoping. Good.
The scanner plays refused-tone for every non-VALID result except ERROR, so REVOKED also plays it. Network errors play nothing, which seems intended.
Backend log shows 429s from the email provider during test approvals. The email queue backs off and retries, so this is not caused by this feature.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed registrations and staff were created, then removed with cleanup_test_data.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login needs login-role-{coordinator|scanner|super_admin}; coordinators also need login-branch-{id}. For audio checks, the tool's page.add_init_script does NOT apply because the page is already loaded and client-side navigation never reloads it. Instead run page.evaluate to wrap HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play after load, then read window.__plays (the src contains welcome-chime.wav or refused-tone.wav). Registration is rate limited at 10/min; _post_rl handles it.
